name: Sweet Sorrow: The Visual Novel
source:
Play as Cyrus, a former vampire hunter who reluctantly returns to his hometown after seven years away. Is it bad luck that brings him to his ex-lover's doorstep, or could it be a chance to reconcile?

[From [url=https://tallimorgan.itch.io/swsr-visual]itch.io[/url]]
